scope: Agency-authored creative mechanisms. Official Deck names are optional labels only; this runtime bank does not require authenticated source access.
attribution: Agency-authored guidance; mechanism labels are retained as recognizable references where useful.

pairing_rules.reason: Near-twin mechanisms usually produce variations, not independent routes. Pair them only when the brief explicitly needs both problem and solution treatments.

tools.name: Glorify People
tools.core: Celebrate people the audience admires.

application.prompt: Whose contribution deserves recognition, and what can the brand credibly do for them?

tools.name: Honour a Place
tools.core: Express a place's shared emotional significance.

application.prompt: Which place matters to this audience, and what would only someone who knows it notice?

tools.name: Get Behind an Attitude
tools.core: Champion a recognizable outlook on life.

application.prompt: What belief can the brand dramatize as a choice the audience recognizes?

tools.name: Elevate a Thing
tools.core: Reveal the significance of an overlooked thing.

application.prompt: What ordinary object becomes valuable when we show what it enables?

tools.name: Celebrate a Journey
tools.core: Connect past effort with present meaning.

application.prompt: Which setbacks and turning points explain why the current benefit matters?

tools.name: Cherish a Moment
tools.core: Recognize an emotionally significant moment.

application.prompt: What small moment does the audience recognize before they have words for it?

tools.name: Empathise and Support
tools.core: Show understanding before offering help.

application.prompt: What does the audience experience, and what support would feel genuinely useful?

tools.name: Dramatise the Problem
tools.core: Amplify a real difficulty so relief becomes meaningful.

application.prompt: Which observed irritation can become one memorable scene without exaggerating the harm?

tools.name: Dramatise the Solution
tools.core: Reveal the benefit behind an intriguing outcome.

application.prompt: What surprising behavior would make sense once viewers understand the benefit?

tools.name: Use an Analogy for the Problem
tools.core: Clarify a problem through a familiar parallel.

application.prompt: What everyday situation has the same structure as the audience's problem?

tools.name: Use an Analogy for the Solution
tools.core: Make a benefit understandable through analogy.

application.prompt: What familiar experience makes this benefit immediately legible?

tools.name: Humanise
tools.core: Give an abstract subject human qualities.

application.prompt: If the invisible problem or function were a character, what would it want and do?

tools.name: Compare and Contrast
tools.core: Use a fair comparison to clarify value.

application.prompt: Which two situations make the benefit understandable when placed together?

tools.name: Rename, Redefine, Reclassify
tools.core: Change perception through useful naming.

application.prompt: What recurring behavior lacks a useful, memorable name?

tools.name: Invite the Audience Backstage
tools.core: Reveal the people and work behind production.

application.prompt: Which verified process or act of care would change how people value the offer?

tools.name: Hire a Surprising Endorser
tools.core: Use an unexpected advocate to make endorsement memorable.

application.prompt: Who can credibly endorse this from an angle the audience would not expect?

tools.name: Transport Them to Other Worlds
tools.core: Invent a world that illuminates product truth.

application.prompt: What fictional world makes the product truth easier to feel or understand?

tools.name: Stand Up for the Little Guy
tools.core: Use brand resources to empower overlooked people.

application.prompt: Which overlooked group can the brand support through a concrete, credible action?

tools.name: Invent a Mascot
tools.core: Give the brand a recurring character with a useful role.

application.prompt: What character rule can make the product truth memorable across a series?

tools.name: Debunk a Stereotype
tools.core: Challenge a reductive assumption through unexpected reality.

application.prompt: Which assumption can evidence and lived experience complicate?

tools.name: Conduct an Experiment
tools.core: Explore a question through a credible test.

application.prompt: What observable test could put the promise under useful pressure?

tools.name: Make the Format the Idea
tools.core: Make a repeatable content structure carry the idea.

application.prompt: What recurring segment, rule, or episode structure would make the audience come back for the next instance?

tools.name: Let the Audience Author It
tools.core: Give the audience a meaningful role in creating the output.

application.prompt: What can people contribute that changes the work rather than merely approving or sharing it?
